notes: Ports 5 and 6 are switchable: each can be used as either an HD-SDI (BNC) input or an HDMI input, giving "6 SDI or 4 SDI + 2 HDMI" total video inputs (modeled here as 6 fixed SDI inputs Input 1-4 plus dedicated Input 5/6 SDI, and 2 separate HDMI inputs for the same physical jacks - see caveat below). Max resolution per manual is 1080i/720p only (no 1080p/3G-SDI mentioned anywhere in the manual's Standards or Specifications tables), so SDI ports are graded sdi-hd, not sdi-3g. HDMI version is never stated in the manual (only resolutions/refresh rates), so HDMI grade is omitted per instructions. RS-232/RS-422 port is physically present but the manual marks it "(TBD)" / not active under current firmware at time of writing. Power input is a 4-pin XLR DC socket (12V/3A external PSU, locking collar), pinout Pin1=GND, Pin4=VCC - this is a true xlr4-dc connector, not a barrel jack (a common assumption). Main processing unit ships with 2x 2U rack-ear brackets per B&H/AVLFX listings, so it is rack-mountable at 2U, though the manual's own dimensions page did not extract as text (image-based) to independently confirm. Console/keyboard port (9-pin D-Sub) connects the separate control panel and is control-only, not modeled as signal I/O. Grounding terminal (screw lug) omitted as it is not a signal/power connector per the schema. Tally output is a D-sub 25-pin female bi-color tally port (open-collector outputs), modeled generically as bidirectional D-sub since no exact connector id exists in the allowed list - closest match used was rs232 is NOT appropriate; used the closest generic serial/control fit is not available either, so it was mapped best-effort. Two separate Ethernet/RJ45 ports exist (PC control/updates, and firmware/file load) - both included in ports list.
